name: medqa_s4_baseline
responses: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.
I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.
I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.
The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication.
